notes.title: Notification of bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixes have been carried out for crashes occurring on the below hardware. Please be sure to install the update dated August 26th 2024.
Hardware for which fixes have been confirmed:
• RX 7000-series hardware, including AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT and AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT
• ASUS ROG Ally RC71L-Z1E512

Affected titles:
◆ The below titles included in KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-
　- KINGDOM HEARTS FINAL MIX
    - KINGDOM HEARTS Re:Chain of Memories
　- KINGDOM HEARTS II FINAL MIX
　- KINGDOM HEARTS Birth by Sleep FINAL MIX

◆ The below titles included in KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
　- KINGDOM HEARTS Dream Drop Distance HD
　- KINGDOM HEARTS χ Back Cover

We apologise to any players who have been affected by this.
If you should find that crashes continue to occur even after installing the update, please contact the SQUARE ENIX support centre.
• KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-
　https://support.na.square-enix.com/main.php?la=1&id=15941
• KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
　https://support.na.square-enix.com/main.php?la=1&id=15501

notes.title: Add KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- to your wishlist now!
notes.notes:
KINGDOM HEARTS is an RPG series born of a dream collaboration between Disney and SQUARE ENIX, and KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- is a compilation of six core games in the series, starting with the very first instalment where it all began.

The Keyblade is a weapon that can only be wielded by those it has chosen. Set out on an adventure through all kinds of Disney worlds as the wielder of the Keyblade, with your companions by your side. Experience new encounters and farewells along your path on this tale of personal growth.
A story full of mystery unfolds around the universal themes of light, darkness, and hearts.

With the release on Steam, in-game environmental textures have been upgraded to an even higher quality!
In this HD Remaster, the worlds of KINGDOM HEARTS are even more beautiful than before.

[h3]<Included Content>[/h3]
[list]
[*] KINGDOM HEARTS FINAL MIX
[*] KINGDOM HEARTS Re:Chain of Memories
[*] KINGDOM HEARTS II FINAL MIX
[*] KINGDOM HEARTS 358/2 Days (cinematic content)
[*] KINGDOM HEARTS Birth by Sleep FINAL MIX
[*] KINGDOM HEARTS Re:coded (cinematic content)
[/list]
